patch_list: Removes all ads (interstitials, banners, app-open) and grants rewarded-video perk boosts instantly on tap (no ad watch) using the correct reward name PERKS_BOOST, verified against a real rewarded event.

Unlocks all in-app purchases for free and bypasses SHA1withRSA receipt verification: every store item is granted instantly without launching the Google Play payment dialog, and any fabricated receipt is accepted.
